name: crossmodel-cli
description: Delegate work from Claude Code or Cursor to an external agentic CLI — OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, xAI Grok, the Cursor CLI, or OpenCode for OpenRouter, Ollama and anything OpenAI-compatible — spending that provider's quota instead of this session's. They sweep your repo and write code in a scope you bound; you review and commit. Ships a deterministic benchmark so you route by evidence, a saver mode for when your quota is nearly spent, and a permission policy that keeps git history yours.
